title: Figure 3: SEM micrograph of alpha-case phase formation on a titanium alloy surface
description: Grayscale scanning electron micrograph (700x, 200 µm scale bar, instrument data strip at bottom) showing needle-like microstructure in grains with an altered surface layer at the right edge. Caption: "Figure 3. Micrograph Showing α Phase Formation at the Surface of a Ti Alloy That has Been Exposed to Air at Elevated Temperature." The text discusses whether alpha case is truly detrimental to Ti alloy sheet structures.
